weights: Rust Q8_0 decoder linears/head; pinned f16 remainder expanded to f32
accumulation: f32 dot products, norm/softmax reductions and logits
rounding: IEEE binary16 round-to-nearest-even, then exact expansion to f32
f16_boundaries: encoder vectors written into the audio placeholder span
each nn.Linear output except the logits head
encoder positional residual after its add
encoder and decoder residual stream after each attention/MLP add
attention probabilities after f32 softmax, before the value dot product
decoder K and V entries on cache insertion (K after RoPE)
unrounded: attention dot-product outputs before the output linear
tau_rule: max(0.1, 2 * max teacher margin at a teacher-forced top-1 disagreement)
graded_rule: teacher margin strictly greater than tau
